title: BlackStuff
description: makes some mace pvp stuff gray,black,red
body: This impressive **Mace PVP** resource pack brings a fresh level of detail and style to everyday Minecraft items. The collection features a powerful glowing red enchanted sword that radiates energy, a formidable spiked red mace designed for intense battles, a striking red curved accessory with smooth textures, a clean gray armor stand ready for equipping gear, a vibrant orange carrot with realistic shading, a polished shiny gray apple that looks delicious, and a menacing player character in sleek dark armor complete with glowing red eyes that give off a true PVP warrior vibe. Every item has been carefully enhanced to look sharper, more immersive, and battle-ready.
